agnes -- NES emulation library, vendored with one tiny local patch.

upstream:  https://github.com/kgabis/agnes
commit:    0e4220b084c467e39c04805d955e78c463feadd0 (master, 2025-12-25)
version:   0.2.0 (AGNES_VERSION_STRING)
license:   MIT (see LICENSE here)
files:     agnes.h (byte-identical to upstream)
           agnes.c (upstream amalgamated build + local APU tap, see below)

Local patch to agnes.c (NOT byte-identical to upstream anymore):
  Upstream has no APU; the bus dispatcher's APU register branches are empty.
  We add two hook calls guarded by #ifdef NES_APU, both marked with a
  "vinx: APU tap" comment:
    - cpu_write8: $4000-$4017 writes forwarded to nes_apu_reg_write()
    - cpu_read8:  $4015 reads answered by nes_apu_reg_read_4015()
  plus the two extern declarations above cpu_write8. The hooks are
  implemented in ../src/apu.c. Without -DNES_APU the file compiles to the
  same code as upstream. When updating the vendored copy, reapply this
  patch (grep for "vinx:").

The core's struct internals (the PPU's screen buffer of palette indices, the
g_colors palette, cpu_read8/cpu_write8) are reached by compiling agnes.c
*into* src/core.c with #include rather than linking it separately -- the
amalgamation marks everything AGNES_INTERNAL=static, so that one translation
unit sees the internals and nothing leaks out of it.
